title: fix(metadata-protocol): a tenant's edit follows its item across the packages of one App
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Wtro5Gqzz97Z6DD47Tkksr)_

Fixes #31593

Clause-②: no — no accept set changes; the lookup scope widens only within one suite (triage 6724363147)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：同一个 App 的某个条目（如视图）在新版本里换了所属包（扁平 → 组合拆包，或回滚），租户对它的修改现在会跟着条目走，在新的所属包下照常生效；按名读取、列表、分层读取三处一致。
- 为什么改：修改是按"编辑当时的所属包"存的，拆包或回滚后读取只找新所属包，修改还在库里却不再生效，客户看到定制"消失"。HotCRM 6.2.0 组合版上线前必须修。
- 风险与回滚：只改读取时的查找范围，不写任何数据，不改保存行为；"同一 App"只从安装记录（`appOf` 读已安装清单）判定，旧模块已卸载时以该行绑定在本 App 的 `.custom` 包为凭据，绝不按 id 前缀猜。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/suite-moved-overlay.ts`（两条判定）、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-overlay-merge.ts`（`servedOverlayRowCandidates` 的候选顺序与 `holdsServedOverlayCandidate`）、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-environment-rows.ts`（按名读取接入）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/meta-overlay-follows-suite.test.ts`，预期 6 个全绿（需先构建 metadata-protocol）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Premise as measured on `origin/main`.** The card measured the edit as a row bound to the base (`package_id = app.objectstack.hotcrm`). On `main` that save is closed (ADR-0146 D11): a save naming the read-only base is refused and prescribes the App's pair, so today the edit lands in `app.objectstack.hotcrm.custom` declaring `overrides: { package: OWNER_AT_THE_TIME, basedOn }`. The pair is one per App (ADR-0146 D3 as amended), so after a suite split only the declaration still names the former owner, and the same symptom recurs: the row is kept, the reads serve the vendor's item. Both shapes are fixed here: the pair's declared override (every edit made on a current kernel) and the pre-close row bound to the base (every edit a tenant made on an earlier release, which `os migrate packageless-overlays` cannot move once the bound base stops shipping the name).

**The rule (option 1, the seat's ruling): a tenant's edit follows its item across the packages of one App.** New module `packages/metadata-protocol/src/suite-moved-overlay.ts`, two pure predicates:

- `isMovedOverrideRowOf(row, base, installed, ships)`: the body declares `overrides.package` = a former owner, not `base`; `base` ships the name and the former owner does not; the former owner is an installed package of `base`'s App, or is no longer installed. Every other check is `isServedOverrideRowOf`'s own, asked of the row as if it named `base` (binding is one of `base`'s pairs, overridable type), so the one predicate stays the one spelling of binding and type.
- `isMovedBaseRowOf(row, base, installed, ships)`: the row is bound to another installed, non-pair package of `base`'s App that no longer ships the name while `base` does, of an overridable type, declaring nothing.

**Same App, from the install record, never a prefix.** Two installed packages are of one App when `appOf` (metadata-core) answers the same App over the registry's installed manifests. When the former owner is no longer installed (rollback from composed to flat), the record is the row's binding to the App's pair: the save door admits a declaration into a pair only for a package of that pair's App (`isPairOf`, ADR-0146 D2 write gate).

**Where it is read: the one served-row resolution, so every read agrees.** `servedOverlayRowCandidates` gains two candidates when the read names which packages ship the item (`ships`, new optional field of the address): the pair's moved override right after the package's own declared override, and a moved base row LAST, after the package-less row (which wins over another package's row, ADR-0146 D8 item 1). `holdsServedOverlayCandidate` is the one reading both readers apply. `findServedOverlayRow` (by-name and layered reads) reads `ships` from `shippedArtifactsOf`; `mergePackageAwareOverlay` (list) reads it from the slot's lower-layer contributions. A moved edit is served as the current owner's item (`overrideOf`, the current owner's envelope). Two former owners' base rows that could both follow are never guessed between. Write addresses pass no `ships` and are unchanged.

**What it never does.** Writes nothing (the row keeps its binding and body; a rollback needs no reverse step). Never takes an item from a package that still ships it. Never reaches an `object` (still `ITEM_LOCKED`, and a stored object row never follows).

Files: `suite-moved-overlay.ts` (new), `protocol-overlay-merge.ts`, `protocol-environment-rows.ts`, `protocol.ts` (two host members passed to `findServedOverlayRow`), the test, a patch changeset. No `packages/spec/**`, no `ui/**`, no `registry.ts`, no `served-override.ts` (#31627's file is not edited). No forced test edits.

## Tests

New `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-overlay-follows-suite.test.ts`, 6 cases. One SQLite file is the tenant DB; each boot is a fresh kernel over it with one version's packages (real `ObjectQL`, `SqlDriver`, registry, protocol; nothing stubbed). Each positive case reads by name with and without `?package=`, the list and the layered `effective`.

1. flat → composed, edit in the App's pair declaring the App: served at the module.
2. composed → flat (rollback), edit declaring the module: served at the App with the module uninstalled; re-upgrade serves it again.
3. flat → composed, a pre-close row bound to the App itself: served at the module.
4. NEGATIVE: a row bound to an unrelated installed App, that App's pair declaring HotCRM's App, and HotCRM's pair declaring the unrelated App: none applies to the module's view.
5. CONTROL: the former owner still ships the view: it keeps its edit, the module serves its own view.
6. CONTROL: an object save naming the owner answers `ITEM_LOCKED`; an object row bound to the App never follows to the module.

<details><summary>Red on main first (69244406, metadata-protocol src unchanged): 3 failed | 3 passed (6)</summary>

```
× flat → composed: the edit saved under the App is served at the module that ships the view now
× composed → flat (rollback): the edit saved under the module is served at the App, though the module is gone
× flat → composed: an edit bound to the App itself (a Regime O row from before the D11 close) follows too
- "bare": "Open cases (ours)",  + "bare": "All",
- "layered": "Open cases (ours)", + "layered": "All",
  "list": [["app.objectstack.hotcrm.service", - "Open cases (ours)" + "All"]],
- "owner": "Open cases (ours)", + "owner": "All",
Tests  3 failed | 3 passed (6)
```
The 3 passes are the NEGATIVE and the two CONTROLs, as on main. A first measurement also confirmed the premise shift: the Regime O save naming the base answers the D11 refusal prescribing `app.objectstack.hotcrm.custom`.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (fix committed first; `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, dist preflight, restore proven blob == HEAD each leg)</summary>

The runtime test resolves `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` through its `dist/`, so each leg rebuilt the package and `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` proved the marker present (2 built files) before the run and absent (all 24 files) after the restore build; the tree was clean against HEAD after each leg.

- **A. Same-App check removed** (`ofOneApp` answers true for any installed pair, blob `05cc47b2` → `51420353`): `Tests 1 failed | 5 passed (6)`, the NEGATIVE case, `expected 'Open cases (ours)' to be 'All'` (the row bound to the unrelated App followed). Restored `05cc47b2` == HEAD.
- **B. "Former owner still ships" guard removed** (blob `05cc47b2` → `322a4e8d`): `Tests 1 failed | 5 passed (6)`, the CONTROL case, the module served the App's edit instead of its own view. Restored `05cc47b2` == HEAD.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The card's acceptance is cloud-side (`composed-version-upgrade.test.ts` case 4); this PR pins the same three facts objectstack-side. The cloud test seeds a base-bound row, the shape case 3 covers.
- `GET /packages/:id/customizations` (`listServedOverrides`) still lists a pair override under the package its declaration names; a moved override is served at the new owner but listed under neither until it is saved again. The item lock resolution is unchanged. Both are named in the report's open questions.

## Verification

Head `0fad163d` (branch `claude/project-thread-jx84uj`). #31614 merged first; `origin/main` merged in at `a59426ee` (merge, no rebase), merge base `8784ccbc`.

- **Build:** `pnpm install` 0; `turbo build --filter ./packages/**` 81/81 after the merge.
- **Tests:** the new file 6/6; runtime `src/domains` slice 34 passed (this file, `meta-legacy-pair-served`, `packages-customizations`); `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 327 files / 22593 tests passed; `@objectstack/objectql` 571 files / 11581 tests passed. Heavy runs through `os-verify-lock.sh` (VERDICT command-exit 0).
- **Typecheck:** metadata-protocol 0, runtime 0.
- **Lint:** eslint over the 4 changed sources and the test, exit 0.
- **Gates:** `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 72 families for these 6 paths; all 72 run at `0fad163d`, each exit 0. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 72 derived, 72 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. One gate along the way: `check:query-options-erasure` first counted the test's untyped option bags (236 → 237); `0fad163d` types them (`EngineQueryOptions`, `DataEngineInsertOptions`) and it reads 236 again.
- **Dogfood:** not owed (no `!` in the title, no narrowing arm: reads widen within one App, no accept set changes).
- **`test:repo`:** declared to CI, not run locally.
